solution:
import numpy as np

def mahalanobis_gating(y: np.ndarray, S: np.ndarray, chi2_thresh: float = 9.488) -> bool:
    inv_S = np.linalg.inv(S)
    d_sq = float(y.T @ inv_S @ y)
    return d_sq <= chi2_thresh
